main.description: Acceptance of a bid on an RFP

rfp.description: Strong reference to the rfp record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.rfp).

bid.description: Strong reference to the bid record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.bid.x402).

payload.description: Strong reference to the proof-of-payment record returned by the bid's payment flow (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.receipts.x402 obtained from the x402 GET against the bids.x402 url). The bidder verifies this before provisioning.

submitEvent.description: Service DID reference (did:web:HOST#pdr_market) of the RFP issuer's market service. Optional; bypasses the need for events to be seen in the firehose. The counterparty calls com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.submitEvent via PDS service-proxying using this value as the atproto-proxy target.
